row.scim_plan: Any X Series plan (X2 and up)
row.evidence: 8x8's Entra SSO and SCIM guide lists 'Any 8x8 X Series subscription' as the prerequisite, and Microsoft's tutorial says 'An 8x8 X series subscription of any level'; the documented SCIM 2.0 API creates, updates, deactivates and reactivates users.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to free: June said SCIM availability was not publicly disclosed, but 8x8's own help centre now states SCIM provisioning needs only 'Any 8x8 X Series subscription' (c23), echoed by Microsoft's tutorial (c35). The pricing page (8x8.com/pricing) returned a Vercel Security Checkpoint (HTTP 429) to curl, WebFetch and the headless renderer on 2026-10-05, so June's prices (X2 $24/u/mo, X4 $44/u/mo) could not be re-verified and were dropped from the numeric fields; X2 is kept as the team plan name because 8x8's developer docs still name X2 and X4 licences (c49). SCIM does not assign X Series licences, and SCIM DELETE only deactivates. Deactivated users keep their licence. The Administration (User Management) REST API is a limited-access beta.

plans.name: X Series (X2, X4 and higher licences)
plans.notes: Tier table not captured: the pricing page was blocked by a Vercel Security Checkpoint. SCIM and SAML/Google SSO are documented for any X Series subscription.

scim.notes: SCIM is optional and configured separately from SSO (c22); 8x8 recommends moving users to SSO before provisioning when usernames differ. Microsoft's tutorial lists Entra SSO as a prerequisite (c37). JumpCloud's guide shows the host as platform-cloud.8x8.com.

auth.token_source: Admin Console > Home > Identity and Security > User Provisioning Integration (SCIM) > 8x8 API Token (Other SCIM Provider for custom clients)
auth.notes: Microsoft describes a long-lived bearer token; turning SCIM off clears the token.

operations.notes: PATCH only changes 'active'; all other edits need a full PUT. Only one client may write (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE). Group sync is claimed in the Okta overview (c28) but no Groups endpoint is documented.

deprovision.data_retained: User is set inactive (greyed out), keeps the X Series licence and settings; softphone login is blocked, desk phones keep inbound and extension calls and emergency calling. Deletion must be done manually in Admin Console.

custom.how: 8x8 extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:8x8:1.1:User carries site (set once, cannot change) and a read-only extension number; the Entra guide maps site as urn:8x8:scim:schemas:extension:8x8user:2.0:User:site.

roles.notes: SCIM cannot assign licences, cost centre or user profile.

limitations.text: SCIM does not assign X Series licences; they must be assigned in Admin Console, individually or by CSV.
Deleting a user is not supported; SCIM DELETE deactivates.
PATCH can only change 'active'; other changes need a full PUT, and omitted attributes are cleared.
Only one SCIM client may write; a second client may only read.
Fields of SCIM-provisioned users are read-only in Admin Console.
OneLogin user sync (SCIM) is not supported.

user_api.notes: Administration API Suite is in limited-access beta: API keys cannot be generated in Admin Console and only beta participants may use it.

capabilities.notes: PUT is in the OpenAPI spec but not implemented in v1.0.0, so updates (including status and licence changes) are not yet possible.

endpoints.purpose: Search/list users with filtering and pagination

limitations.text: Beta, limited access; PUT not implemented in v1.0.0.

okta.notes: OIN '8x8 Inc' page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate (read from page markup); Group Push is not marked.

google.notes: 8x8 supports Google OAuth sign-in (c33), which is social-style sign-in, not SAML; no Google Workspace catalogue page was checked and no Google provisioning is documented.

onelogin.notes: From 8x8's own OneLogin guide: the OneLogin '8x8 app (SAML 2.0, form-based auth)' signs in, and OneLogin SCIM sync is not supported.

fallbacks.notes: Bulk CSV upload is documented for licence assignment and editing; JIT user creation on SSO sign-in is not documented.
